title: Ophthalmologists, Except Pediatric
description: Diagnose and perform surgery to treat and help prevent disorders and diseases of the eye. May also provide vision services for treatment including glasses and contacts.

tasks.text: Perform comprehensive examinations of the visual system to determine the nature or extent of ocular disorders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vision tests require hands-on patient examination

dwas.name: Test patient vision.

tasks.text: Diagnose or treat injuries, disorders, or diseases of the eye and eye structures including the cornea, sclera, conjunctiva, or eyelids.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Diagnose medical conditions.
Treat chronic diseases or disorders.

tasks.text: Provide or direct the provision of postoperative care.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Post-surgical monitoring is hands-on clinical observation

dwas.name: Monitor patients following surgeries or other treatments.

tasks.text: Develop or implement plans and procedures for ophthalmologic services.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical plans need exam, liability, and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Develop medical treatment plans.

tasks.text: Prescribe or administer topical or systemic medications to treat ophthalmic conditions and to manage pain.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing medications is licensed high-stakes judgment

dwas.name: Administer non-intravenous medications.
Prescribe medications.

tasks.text: Develop treatment plans based on patients' histories and goals, the nature and severity of disorders, and treatment risks and benefits.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical plans need exam, liability, and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Develop medical treatment plans.

tasks.text: Perform ophthalmic surgeries such as cataract, glaucoma, refractive, corneal, vitro-retinal, eye muscle, or oculoplastic surgeries.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surgery is physical and high-accountability

dwas.name: Operate on patients to treat conditions.

tasks.text: Educate patients about maintenance and promotion of healthy vision.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Wellness advice needs tailoring and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Provide health and wellness advice to patients, program participants, or caregivers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Document or evaluate patients' medical histories.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Perform, order, or interpret the results of diagnostic or clinical tests.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.
Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.text: Provide ophthalmic consultation to other medical professionals.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical advice needs licensed accountability and context

dwas.name: Advise medical personnel regarding healthcare issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Refer patients for more specialized treatments when conditions exceed the experience, expertise, or scope of practice of practitioner.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.text: Perform laser surgeries to alter, remove, reshape, or replace ocular tissue.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surgery is physical and high-accountability

dwas.name: Operate on patients to treat conditions.

tasks.text: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of health professionals to provide optimal patient care.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Prescribe corrective lenses such as glasses or contact lenses.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Device prescription needs clinical assessment and accountability

dwas.name: Prescribe assistive medical devices or related treatments.

tasks.text: Prescribe ophthalmologic treatments or therapies such as chemotherapy, cryotherapy, or low vision therapy.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing therapy requires licensed clinical accountability

dwas.name: Prescribe treatments or therapies.

tasks.text: Instruct interns, residents, or others in ophthalmologic procedures and techniques.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.

tasks.text: Conduct clinical or laboratory-based research in ophthalmology.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.
